recovery.requirement: Loss of any one signer's device or backup must be recoverable without the treasury being at risk or blocked.
A documented procedure exists to remove a compromised signer and rotate to a new one before the attacker can reach the threshold.
The treasury must remain operable if up to two signers are unavailable at once.
Signer replacement is possible, recorded publicly, and itself requires the threshold.
A documented, tested plan covers loss of more than two signers, including how funds could be recovered or why they could not.

implementation.note: Design only. No wallets, keys or multisig accounts exist, signers are not named, and the multisig mechanism is not chosen.
